title: Michael's son thinks he was dropped off at Area 51

tellings.quote: and his son his son thinks that maybe it was Area 51 where he was dropped off.

plain: In 1977 a man named Michael, one of a group of Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens, was later dropped off somewhere, and his son thinks that place may have been Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. Michels passes on the son's view himself, which, if right, would tie the abduction to the US military.
